lane_override: The aquaporin fold (AQP10 crystal structure) puts both termini in the cytoplasm; UniProt A6NM10 annotates 1-22 cytoplasmic; v1's extra helix at 8-21 is weak. AQP12 is intracellular (ER, zymogen granules), so surface display is doubtful on any lane

Mouse Glp2r (Q5IXF8) starts with a classical signal peptide that aligns to human ~43-66, and DeepTMHMM v2 calls SP 1-66; Tedman's HA-after-Met1 surface signal is ~0.12x the median (PMID 42736269), consistent with an N-terminal tag being lost with a cleaved signal peptide. GLP2R is also an expression-rescue gene (rescue:GLP2R, l1-p2365), so the contrast with its Igk-leader twin changes: the reference is no longer an N-at-residue-1 construct

Mouse and chicken cryo-EM show a 12-TM MFS fold with an extracellular domain formed by the TM5-TM6 loop and a cytoplasmic N-terminus; DeepTMHMM v2, the member's model and the K/R bias (5 vs 15) agree; the v1 call (N-out) is inverted, so an N-terminal cassette would sit in the cytoplasm. Tag site: the TM5-TM6 extracellular loop

Same evidence as the MFSD2A reference (l1-p1213): cryo-EM of mouse and chicken MFSD2A puts the N-terminus in the cytoplasm and the TM5-TM6 loop outside; v2, the model (K/R 5 vs 13) and UniProt agree; v1 is inverted
